title: Machine Learning Engineer
responsibilities: Develop and evaluate machine learning models for business applications.
Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation.
Build reusable Python pipelines for machine learning workflows.
Analyze model performance and investigate errors and data quality issues.
Develop APIs for serving machine learning models in application environments.
Collaborate with software engineers and data teams to integrate models into production systems.
Document experiments, model decisions, and technical findings.
Contribute to improving the reliability and scalability of machine learning systems.
description: We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to develop and productionize machine learning solutions. The role combines Python programming, data processing, model development, experimentation, and software engineering. Candidates with experience deploying models through APIs or working with cloud and MLOps infrastructure will be considered for additional responsibilities.
